Punishment: One half of the imprison-ment for life, or imprison-ment not exceeding one-half of the longest term, provided for the offence, or fine, or both. According as the offence is cognizable or non-cognizable. According as the offence attempted by the offender is bailable or non-bailable. Triable by: The court by which the offence attempted is triable.

section_title: Punishment for rape
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 64 (Punishment for rape)
Section 64(1) - Rape. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 10 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 64(2) - Rape by a police officer or a public servant or member of armed forces or a person being on the management or on the staff of a jail, remand home or other place of custody or women's or children's institution or by a person on the management or on the staff of a hospital, and rape committed by a person in a position of trust or authority towards the person raped or by a near relative of the person raped. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 10 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life which shall mean the remainder of that person's natural life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Punishment for rape in certain cases
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 65 (Punishment for rape in certain cases)
Section 65(1) - Persons committing offence of rape on a woman under sixteen years of age. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 20 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life, which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person's natural life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 65(2) - Persons committing offence of rape on a woman under twelve years of age. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 20 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person's natural life and with fine or death. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Punishment for causing death or resulting in persistent vegetative state of victim
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 66 (Punishment for causing death or resulting in persistent vegetative state of victim)
Section 66 - Person committing an offence of rape and inflicting injury which causes death or causes the woman to be in a persistent vegetative state. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 20 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person's natural life or death. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Sexual intercourse by husband upon his wife during separation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 67 (Sexual intercourse by husband upon his wife during separation)
Section 67 - Sexual intercourse by husband upon his wife during separation. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 2 years but which may extend to 7 years and fine. Cognizable (only on the complaint of the victim). Bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Sexual intercourse by a person in authority
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 68 (Sexual intercourse by a person in authority)
Section 68 - Sexual intercourse by a person in authority, etc. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 5 years, but which may extend to 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Sexual intercourse by employing deceitful means, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 69 (Sexual intercourse by employing deceitful means, etc)
Section 69 - Sexual intercourse by employing deceitful means, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment which may extend to 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Gang rape
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 70 (Gang rape)
Section 70(1) - Gang rape. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 20 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person's natural life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 70(2) - Gang rape on a woman under eighteen years of age. Punishment: Imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person's natural life and with fine or with death. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Punishment for repeat offenders
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 71 (Punishment for repeat offenders)
Section 71 - Repeat offenders. Punishment: Imprisonment for life which shall mean imprisonment for the remainder of that person's natural life or with death. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Disclosure of identity of victim of certain offences, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 72 (Disclosure of identity of victim of certain offences, etc)
Section 72(1) - Disclosure of identity of the victim of certain offences, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Printing or publishing any matter relating to Court proceedings without permission
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 73 (Printing or publishing any matter relating to Court proceedings without permission)
Section 73 - Printing or publication of a proceeding without prior permission of court. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 74 (Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty)
Section 74 - Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year which may extend to 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Sexual harassment
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 75 (Sexual harassment)
Section 75(2) - Sexual harassment and punishment for sexual harassment specified in clause (i) or clause (ii) or clause (iii) of sub-section (1). Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment with 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 75(3) - Sexual harassment and punishment for sexual harassment specified in clause (iv) of sub-section (1). Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to disrobe
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 76 (Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to disrobe)
Section 76 - Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to disrobe. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 3 years but which may extend to 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Voyeurism
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 77 (Voyeurism)
Section 77 - Voyeurism. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 1 year but which may extend to 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 77 - Second or subsequent conviction. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 3 years but which may extend to 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Stalking
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 78 (Stalking)
Section 78(2) - Stalking. Punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 78(2) - Second or subsequent conviction. Punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult modesty of a woman
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 79 (Word, gesture or act intended to insult modesty of a woman)
Section 79 - Uttering any word or making any gesture intended to insult the modesty of a woman, etc. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Dowry death
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 80 (Dowry death)
Section 80(2) - Dowry death. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 7 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Cohabitation caused by man deceitfully inducing belief of lawful marriage
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 81 (Cohabitation caused by man deceitfully inducing belief of lawful marriage)
Section 81 - A man by deceit causing a woman not lawfully married to him to believe, that she is lawfully married to him and to cohabit with him in that belief. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Marrying again during lifetime of husband or wife
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 82 (Marrying again during lifetime of husband or wife)
Section 82(1) - Marrying again during the life time of a husband or wife. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 82(2) - Same offence with concealment of the former marriage from the person with whom subsequent marriage is contracted. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Marriage ceremony fraudulently gone through without lawful marriage
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 83 (Marriage ceremony fraudulently gone through without lawful marriage)
Section 83 - A person with fraudulent intention going through the ceremony of being married, knowing that he is not thereby lawfully married. Punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Enticing or taking away or detaining with criminal intent a married woman
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 84 (Enticing or taking away or detaining with criminal intent a married woman)
Section 84 - Enticing or taking away or detaining with a criminal intent a married woman. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 85 (Husband or relative of husband of a woman subjecting her to cruelty)
Section 85 - Punishment for subjecting a married woman to cruelty. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable if information relating to the commission of the offence is given to an officer in charge of a police station by the person aggrieved by the offence or by any person related to her by blood, marriage or adoption or if there is no such relative, by any public servant belonging to such class or category as may be notified by the State Government in this behalf. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Kidnapping, abducting or inducing woman to compel her marriage, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 87 (Kidnapping, abducting or inducing woman to compel her marriage, etc)
Section 87 - Kidnapping, abducting or inducing woman to compel her marriage, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Causing miscarriage
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 88 (Causing miscarriage)
Section 88 - Causing miscarriage. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 88 - If the woman be quick with child. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Causing miscarriage without woman's consent
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 89 (Causing miscarriage without woman's consent)
Section 89 - Causing miscarriage without women's consent. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Death caused by act done with intent to cause miscarriage
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 90 (Death caused by act done with intent to cause miscarriage)
Section 90(1) - Death caused by an act done with intent to cause miscarriage. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 90(2) - If act done without women's consent. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or as above. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Act done with intent to prevent child being born alive or to cause to die after birth
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 91 (Act done with intent to prevent child being born alive or to cause to die after birth)
Section 91 - Act done with intent to prevent a child being born alive, or to cause it to die after its birth. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Causing death of quick unborn child by act amounting to culpable homicide
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 92 (Causing death of quick unborn child by act amounting to culpable homicide)
Section 92 - Causing death of a quick unborn child by an act amounting to culpable homicide. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Exposure and abandonment of child under twelve years of age, by parent or person having care of it
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 93 (Exposure and abandonment of child under twelve years of age, by parent or person having care of it)
Section 93 - Exposure of a child under 12 years of age by parent or person having care of it with intention of wholly abandoning it. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Concealment of birth by secret disposal of dead body
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 94 (Concealment of birth by secret disposal of dead body)
Section 94 - Concealment of birth by secret disposal of dead body. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Hiring, employing or engaging a child to commit an offence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 95 (Hiring, employing or engaging a child to commit an offence)
Section 95 - Hiring, employing or engaging a child to commit an offence. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 3 years but which may extend to 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 95 - If offence be committed. Punishment: Same as for the offence committed. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court by which offence committed is triable.

section_title: Procuration of child
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 96 (Procuration of child)
Section 96 - Procuration of child. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Kidnapping or abducting child under ten years of age with intent to steal from its person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 97 (Kidnapping or abducting child under ten years of age with intent to steal from its person)
Section 97 - Kidnapping or abducting a child under ten years with intent to steal from its person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Selling child for purposes of prostitution, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 98 (Selling child for purposes of prostitution, etc)
Section 98 - Selling child for purposes of prostitution, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Buying child for purposes of prostitution, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 99 (Buying child for purposes of prostitution, etc)
Section 99 - Buying child for purposes of prostitution, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 7 years but which may extend to 14 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Punishment for murder
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 103 (Punishment for murder)
Section 103(1) - Murder. Punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 103(2) - Murder by group of five or more persons. Punishment: Death or with imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Punishment for murder by life-convict
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 104 (Punishment for murder by life-convict)
Section 104 - Murder by life-convict. Punishment: Death or imprisonment for life, which shall mean the remainder of that person's natural life. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 105 (Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder)
Section 105 - Culpable homicide not amounting to murder, if act by which the death is caused is done with intention of causing death, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or Imprisonment for not less than 5 years but which may extend to 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 105 - If act be done with knowledge that it is likely to cause death, but without any intention to cause death, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and with fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Causing death by negligence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 106 (Causing death by negligence)
Section 106(1) - Causing death by negligence. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 106(1) - Causing death by by registered medical practitioner. Punishment: negligence Imprisonment for 2 years and fine Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 106(2) - Causing death by rash and negligent driving of vehicle and escaping. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Abetment of suicide of child or person of unsound mind
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 107 (Abetment of suicide of child or person of unsound mind)
Section 107 - Abetment of suicide of child or person of unsound mind, etc. Punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Abetment of suicide
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 108 (Abetment of suicide)
Section 108 - Abetment of suicide. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Attempt to murder
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 109 (Attempt to murder)
Section 109(1) - Attempt to murder. If such act causes hurt to any person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Imprisonment for life, or as above. Cognizable. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session. Court of Session.
Section 109(2) - Attempt by life-convict to murder, if hurt is caused. Punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life which shall mean the remainder of that person's natural life. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Attempt to commit culpable homicide
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 110 (Attempt to commit culpable homicide)
Section 110 - Attempt to commit culpable homicide. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 110 - If such act causes hurt to any person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Organised crime
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 111 (Organised crime)
Section 111(2)(a) - Organised crime resulting in death of any person. Punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and fine of not less than 10 lakh rupees. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 111(2)(b) - In any other case. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 5 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine of not less than 5 lakh rupees. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 111(3) - Abetting, attempting, conspiring or knowingly facilitating the commission of organised crime. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 5 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine of not less than 5 lakh rupees. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 111(4) - Being a member of an organised crime syndicate. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 5 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine of not less than 5 lakh rupees. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 111(5) - Intentionally harbouring or concealing any person who committed offence of organised crime. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 3 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine of not less than 5 lakh rupees. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 111(6) - Possessing property or obtained from the commission of organised crime. Punishment: derived, Imprisonment for not less than 3 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine of not less than 2 lakh rupees. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 111(7) - Possessing property on behalf of a member of an organised crime syndicate. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 3 years but which may extend to imprisonment for 10 years and fine of not less than 1 lakh rupees. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Petty organised crime
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 112 (Petty organised crime)
Section 112 - Petty Organised crime. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 1 year but which may extend to 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: act
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 113 (act)
Section 113(2)(a) - Terrorist act resulting in the death of any person. Punishment: Death or imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 113(2)(b) - In any other case. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 5 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 113(3) - Conspiring, attempting, abetting, etc., or knowingly facilitating the commission of terrorist act. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 5 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 113(4) - Organising camps, training, etc., for commission of terrorist act. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 5 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 113(5) - Being a member of an organisation involved in terrorist act. Punishment: Imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 113(6) - Harbouring, concealing, etc., of any person who committed a terrorist act. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 3 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 113(7) - Possessing property derived or obtained from commission of terrorist act. Punishment: Imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Voluntarily causing hurt
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 115 (Voluntarily causing hurt)
Section 115(2) - Voluntarily causing hurt. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 117 (Voluntarily causing grievous hurt)
Section 117(2) - Voluntarily causing grievous hurt. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 117(3) - If hurt to results in permanent disability or persistent vegetative state. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 10 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life which shall mean the remainder of that person's natural life. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 117(4) - Grievous hurt caused by a group of 5 or more persons. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: hurt or hurt dangerous or
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 118 (hurt or hurt dangerous or)
Section 118(1) - Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine of 20,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 118(2) - Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons or means [except as provided in section Punishment: grievous Imprisonment for life or imprisonment of not less than 1 year but which may 122(2)]. extend to 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to extort property, or to constrain to an illegal act
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 119 (Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to extort property, or to constrain to an illegal act)
Section 119(1) - Voluntarily causing hurt to extort property, or to constrain to an illegal act. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 119(2) - Voluntarily causing grievous hurt for any purpose referred to in sub-section (1). Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to extort confession, or to compel restoration of property
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 120 (Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to extort confession, or to compel restoration of property)
Section 120(1) - Voluntarily causing hurt to extort confession or information, or to compel restoration of property, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 120(2) - Voluntarily causing grievous hurt to extort confession or information, or to compel restoration of property, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to deter public servant from his duty
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 121 (Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt to deter public servant from his duty)
Section 121(1) - Voluntarily causing hurt to deter public servant from his duty. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 121(2) - Voluntarily causing grievous hurt to deter public servant from his duty. Punishment: Imprisonment not less than 1 year, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt on provocation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 122 (Voluntarily causing hurt or grievous hurt on provocation)
Section 122(1) - Voluntarily causing hurt on grave and sudden provocation, not intending to hurt any other than the person who gave the provocation. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 122(2) - Causing grievous hurt on grave and sudden provocation, not intending to hurt any other than the person who gave the provocation. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Causing hurt by means of poison, etc., with intent to commit an offence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 123 (Causing hurt by means of poison, etc., with intent to commit an offence)
Section 123 - Causing hurt by means of poison, etc., with intent to commit an offence. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by use of acid, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 124 (Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by use of acid, etc)
Section 124(1) - Voluntarily causing hurt by use of acid, Punishment: grievous Imprisonment for not less etc. than 10 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 124(2) - Voluntarily throwing or attempting to throw acid. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years but which may extend to 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Act endangering life or personal safety of others
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 125 (Act endangering life or personal safety of others)
Section 125 - Doing any act endangering human life or personal safety of others. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 2,500 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 125(a) - Where hurt is caused. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 125(b) - Where grievous hurt is caused. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Wrongful restraint
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 126 (Wrongful restraint)
Section 126(2) - Wrongfully restraining any person. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Wrongful confinement
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 127 (Wrongful confinement)
Section 127(2) - Wrongfully confining any person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 127(3) - Wrongfully confining for three or more days. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 127(4) - Wrongfully confining for 10 or more days. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years and fine of 10,000 rupees. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 127(5) - Keeping any person in wrongful confinement, knowing that a writ has been issued for his liberation. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years in addition to any term of imprisonment to under any other section and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 127(6) - Wrongful confinement in secret. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years in addition to other punishment which he is liable to and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 127(7) - Wrongful confinement for the purpose of extorting property, or constraining to an illegal act, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 127(8) - Wrongful confinement for the purpose of extorting confession or information, or for compelling restoration of property, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Punishment for assault or criminal force otherwise than on grave provocation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 131 (Punishment for assault or criminal force otherwise than on grave provocation)
Section 131 - Assault or criminal force otherwise than on grave provocation. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 1,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Assault or criminal force to deter public servant from discharge of his duty
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 132 (Assault or criminal force to deter public servant from discharge of his duty)
Section 132 - Assault or use of criminal force to deter public servant from discharge of his duty. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Assault or criminal force with intent to dishonour person, otherwise than on grave provocation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 133 (Assault or criminal force with intent to dishonour person, otherwise than on grave provocation)
Section 133 - Assault or criminal force with intent to dishonour a person, otherwise than on grave and sudden provocation. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Assault or criminal force in attempt to commit theft of property carried by a person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 134 (Assault or criminal force in attempt to commit theft of property carried by a person)
Section 134 - Assault or criminal force in attempt to commit theft of property worn or carried by a person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Assault or criminal force in attempt to wrongfully confine a person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 135 (Assault or criminal force in attempt to wrongfully confine a person)
Section 135 - Assault or use of criminal force in attempt wrongfully to confine a person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Assault or criminal force on grave provocation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 136 (Assault or criminal force on grave provocation)
Section 136 - Assault or use of criminal force on grave and sudden provocation. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for one month, or fine of 1,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Kidnapping
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 137 (Kidnapping)
Section 137(2) - Kidnapping. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Kidnapping or maiming a child for purposes of begging
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 139 (Kidnapping or maiming a child for purposes of begging)
Section 139(1) - Kidnapping a child for purposes of begging. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment not be less than 10 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life, and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 139(2) - Maiming a child for purposes of begging. Punishment: Imprisonment not be less than 20 years which may extend to remainder of that person's natural life, and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Kidnapping or abducting in order to murder or for ransom, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 140 (Kidnapping or abducting in order to murder or for ransom, etc)
Section 140(1) - Kidnapping or abducting in order to murder. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 140(2) - Kidnapping for ransom, etc. Punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 140(3) - Kidnapping or abducting with intent secretly and wrongfully to confine a person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 140(4) - Kidnapping or abducting in order to subject a person to grievous hurt, slavery, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Importation of girl or boy from foreign country
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 141 (Importation of girl or boy from foreign country)
Section 141 - Importation of a girl or boy from foreign country. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Wrongfully concealing or keeping in confinement, kidnapped or abducted person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 142 (Wrongfully concealing or keeping in confinement, kidnapped or abducted person)
Section 142 - Wrongfully concealing or keeping in confinement, kidnapped or abducted person. Punishment: Punishment for kidnapping or abduction. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court by which the kidnapping or abduction is triable.

section_title: Trafficking of person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 143 (Trafficking of person)
Section 143(2) - Trafficking of person. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 7 years but which may extend to 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 143(3) - Trafficking of more than one person. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 10 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 143(4) - Trafficking of a child. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 10 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 143(5) - Trafficking of more than one child. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 14 years but which may extend to imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 143(6) - Person convicted of offence of trafficking of child on more than one occasion. Punishment: Imprisonment for life which shall mean the remainder of that person's natural life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 143(7) - Public servant or a police officer involved in trafficking of child. Punishment: Imprisonment for life which shall mean the remainder of that person's natural life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Exploitation of a trafficked person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 144 (Exploitation of a trafficked person)
Section 144(1) - Exploitation of a child. Punishment: trafficked Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 5 years but which may extend to 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 144(2) - Exploitation of a person. Punishment: trafficked Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 3 years but which may extend to 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Habitual dealing in slaves
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 145 (Habitual dealing in slaves)
Section 145 - Habitual dealing in slaves. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Unlawful compulsory labour
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 146 (Unlawful compulsory labour)
Section 146 - Unlawful compulsory labour. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Waging, or attempting to wage war, or abetting waging of war, against Government of India
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 147 (Waging, or attempting to wage war, or abetting waging of war, against Government of India)
Section 147 - Waging or attempting to wage war, or abetting the waging of war, against the Government of India. Punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Conspiracy to commit offences punishable by section 147
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 148 (Conspiracy to commit offences punishable by section 147)
Section 148 - Conspiring to commit certain offences against the State. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Collecting arms, etc., with intention of waging war against Government of India
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 149 (Collecting arms, etc., with intention of waging war against Government of India)
Section 149 - Collecting arms, etc., with the intention of waging war against the Government of India. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Concealing with intent to facilitate design to wage war
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 150 (Concealing with intent to facilitate design to wage war)
Section 150 - Concealing with intent to facilitate a design to wage war. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Assaulting President, Governor, etc., with intent to compel or restrain exercise of any lawful power
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 151 (Assaulting President, Governor, etc., with intent to compel or restrain exercise of any lawful power)
Section 151 - Assaulting President, Governor, etc., with intent to compel or restrain the exercise of any lawful power. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Act endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 152 (Act endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India)
Section 152 - Act endangering sovereignty, unity and integrity of India. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Waging war against Government of any foreign State at peace with Government of India
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 153 (Waging war against Government of any foreign State at peace with Government of India)
Section 153 - Waging war against Government of any foreign State at peace with the Government of India. Punishment: Imprisonment for life and fine, or imprisonment for 7 years and fine, or fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Committing depredation on territories of foreign State at peace with Government of India
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 154 (Committing depredation on territories of foreign State at peace with Government of India)
Section 154 - Committing depredation on the territories of any foreign state at peace with the Government of India. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine, and forfeiture of certain property. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Receiving property taken by war or depredation mentioned in sections 153 and 154
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 155 (Receiving property taken by war or depredation mentioned in sections 153 and 154)
Section 155 - Receiving property taken by war or depredation mentioned in sections 153 and 154. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine, and forfeiture of certain property. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Public servant voluntarily allowing prisoner of State or war to escape
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 156 (Public servant voluntarily allowing prisoner of State or war to escape)
Section 156 - Public servant voluntarily allowing prisoner of state or war in his custody to escape. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Public servant negligently suffering such prisoner to escape
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 157 (Public servant negligently suffering such prisoner to escape)
Section 157 - Public servant negligently suffering prisoner of State or war in his custody to escape. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Aiding escape of, rescuing or harbouring such prisoner
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 158 (Aiding escape of, rescuing or harbouring such prisoner)
Section 158 - Aiding escape of, rescuing or harbouring such prisoner. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Abetting mutiny, or attempting to seduce a soldier, sailor or airman from his duty
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 159 (Abetting mutiny, or attempting to seduce a soldier, sailor or airman from his duty)
Section 159 - Abetting mutiny, or attempting to seduce an officer, soldier, sailor or airman from his allegiance or duty. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 160 (Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof)
Section 160 - Abetment of mutiny, if mutiny is committed in consequence thereof. Punishment: Death, or imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Abetment of assault by soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 161 (Abetment of assault by soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office)
Section 161 - Abetment of assault by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman on his superior officer, when in execution of his office. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Abetment of such assault, if assault committed
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 162 (Abetment of such assault, if assault committed)
Section 162 - Abetment of such assault, if the assault committed. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Abetment of desertion of soldier, sailor or airman
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 163 (Abetment of desertion of soldier, sailor or airman)
Section 163 - Abetment of the desertion of an officer, soldier, sailor or airman. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Harbouring deserter
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 164 (Harbouring deserter)
Section 164 - Harbouring deserter. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Deserter concealed on board merchant vessel through negligence of master
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 165 (Deserter concealed on board merchant vessel through negligence of master)
Section 165 - Deserter concealed on board merchant vessel through negligence of master or person in charge thereof. Punishment: Fine of 3,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Abetment of act of insubordination by soldier, sailor or airman
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 166 (Abetment of act of insubordination by soldier, sailor or airman)
Section 166 - Abetment of act of insubordination by an officer, soldier, sailor or airman if the offence be committed in consequence. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Wearing garb or carrying token used by soldier, sailor or airman
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 168 (Wearing garb or carrying token used by soldier, sailor or airman)
Section 168 - Wearing garb or carrying token used by soldier, sailor or airman. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 2,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Punishment for bribery
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 173 (Punishment for bribery)
Section 173 - Bribery. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year or fine, or both, or if treating only, fine only. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Punishment for undue influence or personation at an election
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 174 (Punishment for undue influence or personation at an election)
Section 174 - Undue influence or personation at an election. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: False statement in connection with an election
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 175 (False statement in connection with an election)
Section 175 - False statement in connection with an election. Punishment: Fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Illegal payments in connection with an election
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 176 (Illegal payments in connection with an election)
Section 176 - Illegal payments in connection with elections. Punishment: Fine of 10,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Failure to keep election accounts
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 177 (Failure to keep election accounts)
Section 177 - Failure to keep election accounts. Punishment: Fine of 5,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Counterfeiting coin, Government stamps, currency-notes or bank-notes
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 178 (Counterfeiting coin, Government stamps, currency-notes or bank-notes)
Section 178 - Counterfeiting coins, government stamps, currency-notes or bank-notes. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Using as genuine, forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 179 (Using as genuine, forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes)
Section 179 - Using as genuine forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp currency-notes or bank-notes. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Possession of forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 180 (Possession of forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes)
Section 180 - Possession of forged or counterfeit coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Making or possessing instruments or materials for forging or counterfeiting coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 181 (Making or possessing instruments or materials for forging or counterfeiting coin, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes)
Section 181 - Making, buying, selling or possessing machinery, instrument or material for forging or counterfeiting coins, Government stamp, currency-notes or bank-notes. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Making or using documents resembling currency-notes or bank-notes
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 182 (Making or using documents resembling currency-notes or bank-notes)
Section 182(1) - Making or using documents resembling currency-notes or bank-notes. Punishment: Fine of 300 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 182(2) - On refusal to disclose the name and address of the printer. Punishment: Fine of 600 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Effacing writing from substance bearing Government stamp, or removing from document a stamp used for it, with intent to cause loss to Government
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 183 (Effacing writing from substance bearing Government stamp, or removing from document a stamp used for it, with intent to cause loss to Government)
Section 183 - Effacing any writing from substance bearing a Government stamp, removing from a document a stamp used for it, with intent to cause a loss to Government. Punishment: a Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Using Government stamp known to have been before used
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 184 (Using Government stamp known to have been before used)
Section 184 - Using a Government stamp known to have been before used. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Erasure of mark denoting that stamp has been used
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 185 (Erasure of mark denoting that stamp has been used)
Section 185 - Erasure of mark denoting that stamps have been used. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: of
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 186 (of)
Section 186 - Fictitious stamps. Punishment: Fine of 200 rupees. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Person employed in mint causing coin to be of different weight or composition from that fixed by law
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 187 (Person employed in mint causing coin to be of different weight or composition from that fixed by law)
Section 187 - Person employed in a Mint causing coin to be of a different weight or composition from that fixed by law. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Unlawfully taking coining instrument from mint
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 188 (Unlawfully taking coining instrument from mint)
Section 188 - Unlawfully taking from a Mint any coining instrument. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Unlawful assembly
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 189 (Unlawful assembly)
Section 189(2) - Being member of an unlawful assembly. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 189(3) - Joining or continuing in an unlawful assembly, knowing that it has been commanded to disperse. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 189(4) - Joining an unlawful assembly armed with any deadly weapon. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 189(5) - Knowingly joining or continuing in any assembly of five or more persons after it has been commanded to disperse. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 189(6) - Hiring, engaging or employing persons to take part in an unlawful assembly. Punishment: The same as for a member of such assembly, and for any offence committed by any member of such assembly. Cognizable. According as offence is bailable or non-bailable. Triable by: The Court by which the offence is triable.
Section 189(7) - Harbouring persons hired for an unlawful assembly. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 189(8) - Being hired to take part in an unlawful assembly or riot. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 189(9) - Or to go armed. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 190 (Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object)
Section 190 - Every member of unlawful assembly guilty of offence committed in prosecution of common object. Punishment: The same as for the offence. According as offence is cognizable or non-cognizable. According as offence is bailable or non-bailable. Triable by: The Court by which the offence is triable.

BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 191
Section 191(2) - Rioting. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 191(3) - Rioting, armed with a deadly weapon. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Wantonly giving provocation with intent to cause riot-if rioting be committed; if not committed
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 192 (Wantonly giving provocation with intent to cause riot-if rioting be committed; if not committed)
Section 192 - Wantonly giving provocation with intent to cause riot, if rioting be committed. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 192 - If not committed. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Liability of owner, occupier, etc., of land on which an unlawful assembly or riot takes place
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 193 (Liability of owner, occupier, etc., of land on which an unlawful assembly or riot takes place)
Section 193(1) - Owner or occupier of land not giving information of riot, etc. Punishment: Fine of 1,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 193(2) - Person for whose benefit or on whose behalf a riot takes place not using all lawful means to prevent it. Punishment: Fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 193(3) - Agent of owner or occupier for whose benefit a riot is committed not using all lawful means to prevent it. Punishment: Fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Affray
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 194 (Affray)
Section 194(2) - Committing affray. Punishment: Imprisonment for one month, or fine of 1,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Assaulting or obstructing public servant when suppressing riot, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 195 (Assaulting or obstructing public servant when suppressing riot, etc)
Section 195(1) - Assaulting or obstructing public servant when suppressing riot, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine not less than 25,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 195(2) - Threatening to assault or attempting to obstruct public servant when suppressing riot, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Promoting enmity between different groups on grounds of religion, race, place of birth, residence, language, etc., and doing acts prejudicial to maintenance of harmony
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 196 (Promoting enmity between different groups on grounds of religion, race, place of birth, residence, language, etc., and doing acts prejudicial to maintenance of harmony)
Section 196(1) - Promoting enmity between different groups on ground of religion, race, place of birth, residence, language, etc., and doing acts prejudicial to maintenance of harmony. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 196(2) - Promoting enmity between classes in place of worship, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Imputations, assertions prejudicial to national integration
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 197 (Imputations, assertions prejudicial to national integration)
Section 197(1) - Imputations, assertions prejudicial to national integration. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 197(2) - If committed in a place of public worship, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Public servant disobeying law, with intent to cause injury to any person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 198 (Public servant disobeying law, with intent to cause injury to any person)
Section 198 - Public servant disobeying direction of the law with intent to cause injury to any person. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Public servant disobeying direction under law
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 199 (Public servant disobeying direction under law)
Section 199 - Public servant disobeying direction under law. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not less than 6 months which may extend to 2 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Punishment for non-treatment of victim
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 200 (Punishment for non-treatment of victim)
Section 200 - Non-treatment of victim by hospital. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Public servant framing an incorrect document with intent to cause injury
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 201 (Public servant framing an incorrect document with intent to cause injury)
Section 201 - Public servant framing an incorrect document with intent to cause injury. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Public servant unlawfully engaging in trade
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 202 (Public servant unlawfully engaging in trade)
Section 202 - Public servant unlawfully engaging in trade. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both, or community service. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Public servant unlawfully buying or bidding for property
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 203 (Public servant unlawfully buying or bidding for property)
Section 203 - Public servant unlawfully buying or bidding for property. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both and confiscation of property, if purchased. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Personating a public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 204 (Personating a public servant)
Section 204 - Personating a public servant. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 6 months but which may extend to 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Wearing garb or carrying token used by public servant with fraudulent intent
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 205 (Wearing garb or carrying token used by public servant with fraudulent intent)
Section 205 - Wearing garb or carrying token used by public servant with fraudulent intent. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Absconding to avoid service of summons or other proceeding
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 206 (Absconding to avoid service of summons or other proceeding)
Section 206(a) - Absconding to avoid service Simple of summons or other 1 month, proceeding from a public 5,000 rupees, servant. Punishment: imprisonment for or fine of or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 206(b) - If summons or notice require attendance in person, etc., in a Court. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Preventing service of summons or other proceeding, or preventing publication thereof
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 207 (Preventing service of summons or other proceeding, or preventing publication thereof)
Section 207(a) - Preventing service of summons or other proceeding, or preventing publication thereof. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 207(b) - If summons, etc., require attendance in person, etc., in a Court. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Non-attendance in obedience to an order from public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 208 (Non-attendance in obedience to an order from public servant)
Section 208(a) - Non-attendance in obedience to an order from public servant. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 208(b) - If the order requires personal attendance, etc., in a Court. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Non-appearance in response to a proclamation under section 84 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 209 (Non-appearance in response to a proclamation under section 84 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023)
Section 209 - Non-appearance in response to a proclamation under section 84 of this Sanhita. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both, or community service. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 209 - In a case where declaration has been made under sub-section (4) of section 84 of this Sanhita pronouncing a person as proclaimed offender. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Omission to produce document or electronic record to public servant by person legally bound to produce it
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 210 (Omission to produce document or electronic record to public servant by person legally bound to produce it)
Section 210(a) - Omission to produce document to public servant by person legally bound to produce or deliver it. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: The Court in which the offence is committed, subject to the provisions of Chapter XXVIII; or, if not committed, in a Court, any Magistrate.
Section 210(b) - If the document is required to be produced in or delivered to a Court. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: The Court in which the offence is committed, subject to the provisions of Chapter XXVIII; or, if not committed, in a Court, any Magistrate.

section_title: Omission to give notice or information to public servant by person legally bound to give it
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 211 (Omission to give notice or information to public servant by person legally bound to give it)
Section 211(a) - Intentional omission to give notice or information to public servant by person legally bound to give it. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 211(b) - If the notice or information required respects the commission of an offence, etc. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 211(c) - If the notice or information is required by an order passed under sub-section (1) of section 394 of this Sanhita. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 1,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Furnishing false information
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 212 (Furnishing false information)
Section 212(a) - Knowingly furnishing false information to public servant. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 212(b) - If the information required respects the commission of an offence, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Refusing oath or affirmation when duly required by public servant to make it
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 213 (Refusing oath or affirmation when duly required by public servant to make it)
Section 213 - Refusing oath when duly required to take oath by a public servant. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: The Court in which the offence is committed, subject to the provisions of Chapter XXVIII; or, if not committed, in a Court, any Magistrate.

section_title: Refusing to answer public servant authorised to question
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 214 (Refusing to answer public servant authorised to question)
Section 214 - Being legally bound to state truth, and refusing to answer public servant authorised to question. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: The Court in which the offence is committed, subject to the provisions of Chapter XXVIII; or, if not committed, in a Court, any Magistrate.

section_title: Refusing to sign statement
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 215 (Refusing to sign statement)
Section 215 - Refusing to sign a statement made to a public servant when legally required to do so. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 3,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: The Court in which the offence is committed, subject to the provisions of Chapter XXVIII; or, if not committed, in a Court, any Magistrate.

section_title: False statement on oath or affirmation to public servant or person authorised to administer an oath or affirmation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 216 (False statement on oath or affirmation to public servant or person authorised to administer an oath or affirmation)
Section 216 - Knowingly stating to a public servant on oath as true that which is false. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: False information, with intent to cause public servant to use his lawful power to injury of another person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 217 (False information, with intent to cause public servant to use his lawful power to injury of another person)
Section 217 - Giving false information to a public servant in order to cause him to use his lawful power to the injury or annoyance of any person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or with fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Resistance to taking of property by lawful authority of a public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 218 (Resistance to taking of property by lawful authority of a public servant)
Section 218 - Resistance to the taking of property by the lawful authority of a public servant. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Obstructing sale of property offered for sale by authority of public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 219 (Obstructing sale of property offered for sale by authority of public servant)
Section 219 - Obstructing sale of property offered for sale by authority of a public servant. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Illegal purchase or bid for property offered for sale by authority of public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 220 (Illegal purchase or bid for property offered for sale by authority of public servant)
Section 220 - Illegal purchase or bid for property offered for sale by authority of public servant. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 200 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Obstructing public servant in discharge of public functions
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 221 (Obstructing public servant in discharge of public functions)
Section 221 - Obstructing public servant in discharge of his public functions. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 2,500 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Omission to assist public servant when bound by law to give assistance
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 222 (Omission to assist public servant when bound by law to give assistance)
