Section 222(a) - Omission to assist public servant when bound by law to give such assistance. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 1 month, or fine of 2,500 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 222(b) - Wilfully neglecting to aid a public servant who demands aid in the execution of process, the prevention of offences, etc. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Disobedience to order duly promulgated by public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 223 (Disobedience to order duly promulgated by public servant)
Section 223(a) - Disobedience to an order lawfully promulgated by a public servant, if such disobedience causes obstruction, annoyance or injury to persons lawfully employed. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 2,500 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 223(b) - If such disobedience causes danger to human life, health or safety, or causes or tends to cause a riot or affray. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Threat of injury to public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 224 (Threat of injury to public servant)
Section 224 - Threat of injury to public servant, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Threat of injury to induce person to refrain from applying for protection to public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 225 (Threat of injury to induce person to refrain from applying for protection to public servant)
Section 225 - Threat of injury to induce person to refrain from applying for protection to public servant. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Attempt to commit suicide to compel or restrain exercise of lawful power
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 226 (Attempt to commit suicide to compel or restrain exercise of lawful power)
Section 226 - Attempt to commit suicide to compel or restraint exercise of lawful power. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both, or community service. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Punishment for false evidence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 229 (Punishment for false evidence)
Section 229(1) - Intentionally giving or fabricating false evidence in a judicial proceeding. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and 10,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 229(2) - Giving or fabricating false evidence in any other case. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and 5,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Giving or fabricating false evidence with intent to procure conviction of capital offence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 230 (Giving or fabricating false evidence with intent to procure conviction of capital offence)
Section 230(1) - Giving or fabricating false evidence with intent to cause any person to be convicted of capital offence. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and 50,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 230(2) - If innocent person be thereby convicted and executed. Punishment: Death, or as above. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Giving or fabricating false evidence with intent to procure conviction of offence punishable with imprisonment for life or imprisonment
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 231 (Giving or fabricating false evidence with intent to procure conviction of offence punishable with imprisonment for life or imprisonment)
Section 231 - Giving or fabricating false evidence with intent to procure conviction of an offence punishable with imprisonment for life or with imprisonment for 7 years, or upwards. Punishment: The same as for the offence. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Threatening any person to give false evidence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 232 (Threatening any person to give false evidence)
Section 232(1) - Threatening any person to give false evidence. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court by which offence of giving false evidence is triable.
Section 232(2) - If innocent person is convicted and sentenced consequence of false evidence with death, or imprisonment for more than 7 years. Punishment: The same as for the in offence. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court by which offence of giving false evidence is triable.

section_title: Using evidence known to be false
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 233 (Using evidence known to be false)
Section 233 - Using in a judicial proceeding evidence known to be false or fabricated. Punishment: The same as for giving or fabricating false evidence. Non-cognizable. According as offence of giving such evidence is bailable or non-bailable. Triable by: Court by which offence of giving or fabricating false evidence is triable.

section_title: Issuing or signing false certificate
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 234 (Issuing or signing false certificate)
Section 234 - Knowingly issuing or signing a false certificate relating to any fact of which such certificate is by law admissible in evidence. Punishment: The same as for giving false evidence. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court by which offence of giving false evidence is triable.

section_title: Using as true a certificate known to be false
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 235 (Using as true a certificate known to be false)
Section 235 - Using as a true certificate one known to be false in a material point. Punishment: The same as for giving false evidence. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court by which offence of giving false evidence is triable.

section_title: False statement made in declaration which is by law receivable as evidence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 236 (False statement made in declaration which is by law receivable as evidence)
Section 236 - False statement made in any declaration which is by law receivable as evidence. Punishment: The same as for giving false evidence. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court by which offence of giving false evidence is triable.

section_title: Using as true such declaration knowing it to be false
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 237 (Using as true such declaration knowing it to be false)
Section 237 - Using as true any such declaration known to be false. Punishment: The same as for giving false evidence. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court by which offence of giving false evidence is triable.

section_title: Causing disappearance of evidence of offence, or giving false information to screen offender
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 238 (Causing disappearance of evidence of offence, or giving false information to screen offender)
Section 238(a) - Causing disappearance of evidence of an offence committed, or giving false information touching it to screen the offender, if a capital offence. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. According as the offence in relation to which disappearance of evidence is caused is cognizable or non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 238(b) - If punishable with imprisonment for life or imprisonment for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 238(c) - If punishable with less than 10 years' imprisonment. Punishment: Imprisonment for one-fourth of the longest term provided for the offence, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court by which the offence is triable.

section_title: Intentional omission to give information of offence by person bound to inform
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 239 (Intentional omission to give information of offence by person bound to inform)
Section 239 - Intentional omission to give information of an offence by a person legally bound to inform. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Giving false information respecting an offence committed
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 240 (Giving false information respecting an offence committed)
Section 240 - Giving false information respecting an offence committed. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Destruction of document or electronic record to prevent its production as evidence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 241 (Destruction of document or electronic record to prevent its production as evidence)
Section 241 - Secreting or destroying any document to prevent its production as evidence. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: False personation for purpose of act or proceeding in suit or prosecution
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 242 (False personation for purpose of act or proceeding in suit or prosecution)
Section 242 - False personation for the purpose of any act or proceeding in a suit or criminal prosecution, or for becoming bail or security. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Fraudulent removal or concealment of property to prevent its seizure as forfeited or in execution
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 243 (Fraudulent removal or concealment of property to prevent its seizure as forfeited or in execution)
Section 243 - Fraudulent removal or concealment, etc., of property to prevent its seizure as a forfeiture or in satisfaction of a fine under sentence, or in execution of a decree. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Fraudulent claim to property to prevent its seizure as forfeited or in execution
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 244 (Fraudulent claim to property to prevent its seizure as forfeited or in execution)
Section 244 - Claiming property without right, or practising deception touching any right to it, to prevent its being taken as a forfeiture, or in satisfaction of a fine under sentence, or in execution of a decree. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Fraudulently suffering decree for sum not due
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 245 (Fraudulently suffering decree for sum not due)
Section 245 - Fraudulently suffering a decree to pass for a sum not due, or suffering decree to be executed after it has been satisfied. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Dishonestly making false claim in Court
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 246 (Dishonestly making false claim in Court)
Section 246 - False claim in a Court. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Fraudulently obtaining decree for sum not due
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 247 (Fraudulently obtaining decree for sum not due)
Section 247 - Fraudulently obtaining a decree for a sum not due, or causing a decree to be executed after it has been satisfied. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: False charge of offence made with intent to injure
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 248 (False charge of offence made with intent to injure)
Section 248(a) - False charge of offence made with intent to injure. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine of 2 lakh rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 248(b) - Criminal proceeding instituted on a false charge of an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for ten years or upwards. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Harbouring offender
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 249 (Harbouring offender)
Section 249(a) - Harbouring an offender, if the offence is punishable with death. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 249(b) - If punishable with imprisonment for life or with imprisonment for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 249(c) - If punishable with imprisonment for 1 year and not for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for one-fourth of the longest term, and of the descriptions, provided for the offence, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Taking gift, etc., to screen an offender from punishment
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 250 (Taking gift, etc., to screen an offender from punishment)
Section 250(a) - Taking gift, etc., to screen an offender from punishment if the offence is punishable with death. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 250(b) - If punishable with imprisonment for life or with imprisonment for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 250(c) - If punishable with imprisonment for less than 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for one-fourth of the longest term provided for the offence, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Offering gift or restoration of property in consideration of screening offender
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 251 (Offering gift or restoration of property in consideration of screening offender)
Section 251(a) - Offering gift or restoration of property in consideration of screening offender if the offence is punishable with death. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 251(b) - If punishable with imprisonment for life or with imprisonment for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 251(c) - If punishable with imprisonment for less than 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for one-fourth of the longest term, provided for the offence, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Taking gift to help to recover stolen property, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 252 (Taking gift to help to recover stolen property, etc)
Section 252 - Taking gift to help to recover movable property of which a person has been deprived by an offence without causing apprehension of offender. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Harbouring offender who has escaped from custody or whose apprehension has been ordered
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 253 (Harbouring offender who has escaped from custody or whose apprehension has been ordered)
Section 253(a) - Harbouring an offender who has escaped from custody, or whose apprehension has been ordered, if the offence is punishable with death. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 253(b) - If punishable with imprisonment for life or with imprisonment for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, with or without fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 253(c) - If punishable with imprisonment for 1 year and not for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for one-fourth of the longest term provided for the offence, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Penalty for harbouring robbers or dacoits
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 254 (Penalty for harbouring robbers or dacoits)
Section 254 - Harbouring robbers or dacoits. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Public servant disobeying direction of law with intent to save person from punishment or property from forfeiture
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 255 (Public servant disobeying direction of law with intent to save person from punishment or property from forfeiture)
Section 255 - Public servant disobeying a direction of law with intent to save person from punishment, or property from forfeiture. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Public servant framing incorrect record or writing with intent to save person from punishment or property from forfeiture
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 256 (Public servant framing incorrect record or writing with intent to save person from punishment or property from forfeiture)
Section 256 - Public servant framing an incorrect record or writing with intent to save person from punishment, or property from forfeiture. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Public servant in judicial proceeding corruptly making report, etc., contrary to law
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 257 (Public servant in judicial proceeding corruptly making report, etc., contrary to law)
Section 257 - Public servant in a judicial proceeding corruptly making and pronouncing an order, report, etc. contrary to law. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Commitment for trial or confinement by person having authority who knows that he is acting contrary to law
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 258 (Commitment for trial or confinement by person having authority who knows that he is acting contrary to law)
Section 258 - Commitment for trial or confinement by a person having authority, who knows that he is acting contrary to law. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Intentional omission to apprehend on part of public servant bound to apprehend
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 259 (Intentional omission to apprehend on part of public servant bound to apprehend)
Section 259(a) - Intentional omission to apprehend on the part of a public servant bound by law to apprehend an offender, if the offence is punishable with death. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, with or without fine. According as the offence in relation to which such omission has been made is cognizable or non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 259(b) - If punishable with imprisonment for life or imprisonment for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, with or without fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 259(c) - If punishable with imprisonment for less than 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, with or without fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Intentional omission to apprehend on part of public servant bound to apprehend person under sentence or lawfully committed
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 260 (Intentional omission to apprehend on part of public servant bound to apprehend person under sentence or lawfully committed)
Section 260(a) - Intentional omission to apprehend on the part of a public servant bound by law to apprehend person under sentence of a Court if under sentence of death. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 14 years, with or without fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 260(b) - If under sentence of imprisonment for life or imprisonment for 10 years, or upwards. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, with or without fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 260(c) - If under sentence of imprisonment for less than 10 years or lawfully committed to custody. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Escape from confinement or custody negligently suffered by public servant
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 261 (Escape from confinement or custody negligently suffered by public servant)
Section 261 - Escape from confinement negligently suffered by a public servant. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Resistance or obstruction by a person to his lawful apprehension
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 262 (Resistance or obstruction by a person to his lawful apprehension)
Section 262 - Resistance or obstruction by a person to his lawful apprehension. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Resistance or obstruction to lawful apprehension of another person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 263 (Resistance or obstruction to lawful apprehension of another person)
Section 263(a) - Resistance or obstruction to the lawful apprehension of any person, or rescuing him from lawful custody. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 263(b) - If charged with an offence punishable with imprison-ment for life or imprison-ment for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 263(c) - If charged with offence punishable with death. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 263(d) - If the person is sentenced to imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years, or upwards. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 263(e) - If under sentence of death. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Omission to apprehend, or sufferance of escape, on part of public servant, in cases not otherwise provided for
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 264 (Omission to apprehend, or sufferance of escape, on part of public servant, in cases not otherwise provided for )
Section 264 - Omission to apprehend, or sufferance of escape on part of public servant, in cases not otherwise provided for:— (a) in case of intentional omission or sufferance; Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 264 - (b) in case of negligent omission or sufferance. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: or to
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 265 (or to)
Section 265 - Resistance or obstruction lawful apprehension, or escape or rescue in cases not otherwise provided for. Punishment: to Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: of of of
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 266 (of of of)
Section 266 - Violation of condition of remission of punishment. Punishment: Punishment of original sentence, or if part of the punishment has been undergone, the residue. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: The Court by which the original offence was triable.

section_title: Intentional insult or interruption to public servant sitting in judicial proceeding
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 267 (Intentional insult or interruption to public servant sitting in judicial proceeding)
Section 267 - Intentional insult or interruption to a public servant sitting in any stage of a judicial proceeding. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: The Court in which the offence is committed, subject to the provisions of Chapter XXVIII; or, if not committed, in a Court, any Magistrate.

section_title: Personation of assessor
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 268 (Personation of assessor)
Section 268 - Personation of an assessor. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: by
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 269 (by)
Section 269 - Failure by person released on bond or bail bond to appear in Court. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Negligent act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 271 (Negligent act likely to spread infection of disease dangerous to life)
Section 271 - Negligently doing any act known to be likely to spread infection of any disease dangerous to life. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: M alignant act likely to spread infection of diseasedangerous to life
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 272 (M alignant act likely to spread infection of diseasedangerous to life)
Section 272 - Malignantly doing any act known to be likely to spread infection of any disease dangerous to life. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Disobedience to quarantine rule
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 273 (Disobedience to quarantine rule)
Section 273 - Knowingly disobeying any quarantine rule. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Adulteration of food or drink intended for sale
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 274 (Adulteration of food or drink intended for sale)
Section 274 - Adulterating food or drink intended for sale, so as to make the same noxious. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Sale of noxious food or drink
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 275 (Sale of noxious food or drink)
Section 275 - Selling any food or drink as food and drink, knowing the same to be noxious. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Adulteration of drugs
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 276 (Adulteration of drugs)
Section 276 - Adulterating any drug or medical preparation intended for sale so as to lessen its efficacy, or to change its operation, or to make it noxious. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Sale of adulterated drugs
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 277 (Sale of adulterated drugs)
Section 277 - Sale of adulterated drugs. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Sale of drug as a different drug or preparation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 278 (Sale of drug as a different drug or preparation)
Section 278 - Knowingly selling of drug as a different drug or preparation. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Fouling water of public spring or reservoir
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 279 (Fouling water of public spring or reservoir)
Section 279 - Fouling water of public spring or reservoir. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Making atmosphere noxious to health
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 280 (Making atmosphere noxious to health)
Section 280 - Making atmosphere noxious to health. Punishment: Fine of 1,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Rash driving or riding on a public way
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 281 (Rash driving or riding on a public way)
Section 281 - Rash driving or riding on a public way. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 1,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Rash navigation of vessel
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 282 (Rash navigation of vessel)
Section 282 - Rash navigation of vessel. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 10,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Exhibition of false light, mark or buoy
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 283 (Exhibition of false light, mark or buoy)
Section 283 - Exhibition of a false light, mark or buoy. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, and fine which shall not be less than 10,000 rupees. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Conveying person by water for hire in unsafe or overloaded vessel
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 284 (Conveying person by water for hire in unsafe or overloaded vessel)
Section 284 - Conveying person by water for hire in unsafe or overloaded vessel. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Danger or obstruction in public way or line of navigation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 285 (Danger or obstruction in public way or line of navigation)
Section 285 - Causing danger or obstruction in public way or line of navigation. Punishment: Fine of 5,000 rupees. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Negligent conduct with respect to poisonous substance
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 286 (Negligent conduct with respect to poisonous substance)
Section 286 - Negligent conduct with respect to poisonous substance. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Negligent conduct with respect to fire or combustible matter
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 287 (Negligent conduct with respect to fire or combustible matter)
Section 287 - Negligent conduct with respect to fire or combustible matter. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 2,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Negligent conduct with respect to explosive substance
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 288 (Negligent conduct with respect to explosive substance)
Section 288 - Negligent conduct with respect to explosive substance. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Negligent conduct with respect to machinery
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 289 (Negligent conduct with respect to machinery)
Section 289 - Negligent conduct with respect to machinery. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Negligent conduct with respect to pulling down, repairing or constructing buildings, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 290 (Negligent conduct with respect to pulling down, repairing or constructing buildings, etc)
Section 290 - Negligent conduct with respect to pulling down, repairing or constructing buildings, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Negligent conduct with respect to animal
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 291 (Negligent conduct with respect to animal)
Section 291 - Negligent conduct with respect to animal. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Punishment for public nuisance in cases not otherwise provided for
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 292 (Punishment for public nuisance in cases not otherwise provided for)
Section 292 - Committing public in cases not otherwise provided for. Punishment: nuisance Fine of 1,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Continuance of nuisance after injunction to discontinue
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 293 (Continuance of nuisance after injunction to discontinue)
Section 293 - Continuance of nuisance after injunction to discontinue. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 6 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Sale, etc., of obscene books, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 294 (Sale, etc., of obscene books, etc)
Section 294(2) - Sale, etc., of obscene books, etc. Punishment: On first conviction, with imprisonment for 2 years, and with fine of 5,000 rupees, and, in the event of second or subsequent conviction, with imprisonment for 5 years, and with fine of 10,000 rupees. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Sale, etc., of obscene objects to child
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 295 (Sale, etc., of obscene objects to child)
Section 295 - Sale, etc., of obscene objects to child. Punishment: On first conviction, with imprisonment for 3 years, and with fine of 2,000 rupees, and in the event of second or subsequent conviction, with imprisonment for 7 years, and with fine of 5,000 rupees. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Obscene acts and songs
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 296 (Obscene acts and songs)
Section 296 - Obscene acts and songs. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 1,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Keeping lottery office
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 297 (Keeping lottery office)
Section 297(1) - Keeping a lottery office. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 297(2) - Publishing proposals relating to lotteries. Punishment: Fine of 5,000 rupees. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Injuring or defiling place of worship with intent to insult religion of any class
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 298 (Injuring or defiling place of worship with intent to insult religion of any class)
Section 298 - Defiling, etc., place of worship, with intent to insult the religion of any class. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Deliberate and malicious acts, intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 299 (Deliberate and malicious acts, intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs)
Section 299 - Deliberate and malicious acts, intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Disturbing religious assembly
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 300 (Disturbing religious assembly)
Section 300 - Disturbing religious assembly. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Trespassing on burial places, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 301 (Trespassing on burial places, etc)
Section 301 - Trespassing on burial places, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Uttering words, etc., with deliberate intent to wound religious feelings of any person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 302 (Uttering words, etc., with deliberate intent to wound religious feelings of any person)
Section 302 - Uttering words, etc., with deliberate intent to wound religious feelings. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Theft
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 303 (Theft)
Section 303(2) - Theft. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for not be less than 1 year but which may extend to 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 303(2) - Where value of property is less than 5,000 rupees. Punishment: Upon return of the value of property or restoration of the stolen property, shall be punished with community service. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Snatching
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 304 (Snatching)
Section 304(2) - Snatching. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Theft in a dwelling house, or means of transportation or place of worship, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 305 (Theft in a dwelling house, or means of transportation or place of worship, etc)
Section 305 - Theft in a dwelling house, or means of transportation or place of worship, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Theft by clerk or servant of property in possession of master
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 306 (Theft by clerk or servant of property in possession of master)
Section 306 - Theft by clerk or servant of property in possession of master or employer. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to committing of theft
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 307 (Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to committing of theft)
Section 307 - Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of theft. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Extortion
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 308 (Extortion)
Section 308(2) - Extortion. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 308(3) - Putting or attempting to put in fear of injury, in order to commit extortion. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 308(4) - Putting or attempting to put a person in fear of death or grievous hurt in order to commit extortion. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 308(5) - Extortion by putting a person in fear of death or grievous hurt. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 308(6) - Putting a person in fear of accusation of an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years in order to commit extortion. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 308(7) - Extortion by threat of accusation of an offence punishable with death, imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Robbery
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 309 (Robbery)
Section 309(4) - Robbery. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 309(4) - If robbery committed on highway between sunset and sunrise. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for 14 years. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 309(5) - Attempt to commit robbery. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 309(6) - Causing hurt. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Dacoity
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 310 (Dacoity)
Section 310(2) - Dacoity. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 310(3) - Murder in dacoity. Punishment: Death, imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for not less than 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 310(4) - Making preparation to commit dacoity. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 310(5) - Being one of five or more persons assembled for the purpose of committing dacoity. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 310(6) - Belonging to a gang of persons associated for the purpose of habitually committing dacoity. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Robbery, or dacoity, with attempt to cause death or grievous hurt
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 311 (Robbery, or dacoity, with attempt to cause death or grievous hurt)
Section 311 - Robbery or dacoity, with attempt to cause death or grievous hurt. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 7 years. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Attempt to commit robbery or dacoity when armed with deadly weapon
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 312 (Attempt to commit robbery or dacoity when armed with deadly weapon)
Section 312 - Attempt to commit robbery or dacoity when armed with deadly weapon. Punishment: Imprisonment for not less than 7 years. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Punishment for belonging to gang of robbers, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 313 (Punishment for belonging to gang of robbers, etc)
Section 313 - Belonging to a wandering gang of persons associated for the purpose of habitually committing thefts. Punishment: Rigorous imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Dishonest misappropriation of property
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 314 (Dishonest misappropriation of property)
Section 314 - Dishonest misappropriation of movable property, or converting it to one's own use. Punishment: Imprisonment of not less than 6 months but which may extend to 2 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Dishonest misappropriation of property possessed by
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 315 (Dishonest misappropriation of property possessed by)
Section 315 - Dishonest misappropriation of property possessed by deceased person at the time of his death. If by clerk or person employed by deceased. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Imprisonment for 7 years. Non-cognizable. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class. Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Criminal breach of trust
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 316 (Criminal breach of trust)
Section 316(2) - Criminal breach of trust. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 316(3) - Criminal breach of trust by a carrier, wharfinger, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 316(4) - Criminal breach of trust by a clerk or servant. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 316(5) - Criminal breach of trust by public servant or by banker, merchant or agent, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Stolen property
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 317 (Stolen property)
Section 317(2) - Dishonestly receiving stolen property knowing it to be stolen. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 317(3) - Dishonestly receiving stolen property, knowing that it was obtained by dacoity. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 317(4) - Habitually dealing in stolen property. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 317(5) - Assisting in concealment or disposal of stolen property, knowing it to be stolen. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Cheating
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 318 (Cheating)
Section 318(2) - Cheating. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 318(3) - Cheating a person whose interest the offender was bound, either by law or by legal contract, to protect. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 318(4) - Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Cheating by personation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 319 (Cheating by personation)
Section 319(2) - Cheating by personation. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or with fine, or with both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Dishonest or fraudulent removal or concealment of property to prevent distribution among creditors
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 320 (Dishonest or fraudulent removal or concealment of property to prevent distribution among creditors)
Section 320 - Fraudulent removal or concealment of property, etc., to prevent distribution among creditors. Punishment: Imprisonment of not be less than 6 months but which may extend to 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Dishonestly or fraudulently preventing debt being available for creditors
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 321 (Dishonestly or fraudulently preventing debt being available for creditors)
Section 321 - Dishonest or fraudulently preventing from being made available for his creditors a debt or demand due to the offender. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Dishonest or fraudulent execution of deed of transfer containing false statement of consideration
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 322 (Dishonest or fraudulent execution of deed of transfer containing false statement of consideration)
Section 322 - Dishonest or fraudulent execution of deed of transfer containing a false statement of consideration. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Dishonest or fraudulent removal or concealment of property
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 323 (Dishonest or fraudulent removal or concealment of property)
Section 323 - Fraudulent removal or concealment of property, of himself or any other person or assisting in the doing thereof, or dishonestly releasing any demand or claim to which he is entitled. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Mischief
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 324 (Mischief)
Section 324(2) - Mischief. Punishment: Imprisonment for 6 months, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 324(3) - Mischief causing loss or damage to any property including property of Government or Local Authority. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 324(4) - Mischief causing loss or damage to the amount of twenty thousand rupees but less than 2 lakh rupees. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 324(5) - Mischief causing loss or damage to the amount of one lakh rupees or upwards. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 324(6) - Mischief with preparation for causing to any person death, or hurt, or wrongful restraint, or fear of death, or of hurt, or of wrongful restraint. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Mischief by killing or maiming animal
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 325 (Mischief by killing or maiming animal)
Section 325 - Mischief by killing or maiming animal. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Mischief by injury, inundation, fire or explosive substance, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 326 (Mischief by injury, inundation, fire or explosive substance, etc)
Section 326(a) - Mischief by causing diminution of supply of water for agricultural purposes, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 326(b) - Mischief by injury to public road, bridge, navigable river, or navigable channel, and rendering it impassable or less safe for travelling or conveying property. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 326(c) - Mischief by causing inundation or obstruction to public drainage attended with damage. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years, or with fine, or with both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 326(d) - Mischief by destroying or moving or rendering less useful a lighthouse or seamark, or by exhibiting false lights. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 326(e) - Mischief by destroying or moving, etc., a landmark fixed by public authority. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 326(f) - Mischief by fire or explosive substance with intent to cause damage. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 326(g) - Mischief by fire or explosive substance with intent to destroy a house, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Mischief with intent to destroy or make unsafe a rail, aircraft, decked vessel or one of twenty tons burden
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 327 (Mischief with intent to destroy or make unsafe a rail, aircraft, decked vessel or one of twenty tons burden)
Section 327(1) - Mischief with intent to destroy or make unsafe a decked vessel or a vessel of 20 tonnes burden. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 327(2) - The mischief described in the last section when committed by fire or any explosive substance. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Punishment for intentionally running vessel aground or ashore with intent to commit theft, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 328 (Punishment for intentionally running vessel aground or ashore with intent to commit theft, etc)
Section 328 - Running vessel with intent to commit theft, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: Criminal trespass and house-trespass
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 329 (Criminal trespass and house-trespass)
Section 329(3) - Criminal trespass. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 329(4) - House-trespass. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Punishment for house-trespass or house-breaking
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 331 (Punishment for house-trespass or house-breaking)
Section 331(1) - Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 331(2) - Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 331(3) - Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking in order to the commission of an offence punishable with imprisonment. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 331(3) - If the offence be theft. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 331(4) - Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night in order to the commission of an offence punishable with imprisonment. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 331(4) - If the offence be theft. Punishment: Imprisonment for 14 years. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 331(5) - Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking after preparation made for causing hurt, assault, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 331(6) - Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night, after preparation made for causing hurt, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 14 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 331(7) - Grievous hurt caused whilst committing lurking house-trespass or house-breaking. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 331(8) - Death or grievous hurt caused by one of several persons jointly concerned in house-breaking by night, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.

section_title: House-trespass in order to commit offence
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 332 (House-trespass in order to commit offence)
Section 332(a) - House-trespass in order to the commission of an offence punishable with death. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or rigorous imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 332(b) - House-trespass in order to the commission of an offence punishable with imprisonment for life. Punishment: Imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 332(c) - House-trespass in order to the commission of an offence punishable with imprisonment. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 332(c) - If the offence is theft. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: House-trespass after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 333 (House-trespass after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint)
Section 333 - House-trespass, having made preparation for causing hurt, assault, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Dishonestly breaking open receptacle containing property
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 334 (Dishonestly breaking open receptacle containing property)
Section 334(1) - Dishonestly breaking open or unfastening any closed receptacle containing or supposed to contain property. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 334(2) - Being entrusted with any closed receptacle containing or supposed to contain any property, and fraudulently opening the same. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Forgery
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 336 (Forgery)
Section 336(2) - Forgery. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 336(3) - Forgery for the purpose of cheating. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 336(4) - Forgery for the purpose of harming the reputation of any person or knowing that it is likely to be used for that purpose. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Forgery of record of Court or of public register, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 337 (Forgery of record of Court or of public register, etc)
Section 337 - Forgery of a record of a Court or of a Registrar of Births, etc., kept by a public servant. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Forgery of valuable security, will, etc
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 338 (Forgery of valuable security, will, etc)
Section 338 - Forgery of a valuable security, will, or authority to make or transfer any valuable security, or to receive any money, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 338 - When the valuable security is a promissory note of the Central Government. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 10 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Having possession of document described in section 337 or section 338, knowing it to be forged and intending to use it as genuine. Forged document or electronic record and using it as genuine
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 339 (Having possession of document described in section 337 or section 338, knowing it to be forged and intending to use it as genuine. Forged document or electronic record and using it as genuine)
Section 339 - Having possession of a document, knowing it to be forged, with intent to use as genuine; if the document is one of the description mentioned in section 337. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. it Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 339 - If the document is one of the description mentioned in section 338. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 340
Section 340(2) - Using as genuine a forged document which is known to be forged. Punishment: Punishment for forgery of such document. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Making or possessing counterfeit seal, etc., with intent to commit forgery punishable under section 338
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 341 (Making or possessing counterfeit seal, etc., with intent to commit forgery punishable under section 338)
Section 341(1) - Making or counterfeiting a seal, plate, etc., with intent to commit a forgery punishable under section 338 or possessing with like intent any such seal, plate, etc., knowing the same to be counterfeit. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 341(2) - Making or counterfeiting a seal, plate, etc., with intent to commit a forgery punishable otherwise than under section 338 or possessing with like intent any such seal, plate, etc., knowing the same to be counterfeit. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 341(3) - Possesses any seal, plate or other instrument knowing the same to be counterfeit. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 341(4) - Fraudulently or dishonestly uses as genuine any seal, plate or other instrument knowing or having reason to believe the same to be counterfeit. Punishment: Same as if he had made or counterfeited such seal, plate or other instrument. Cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Counterfeiting device or mark used for authenticating documents described in section 338, or possessing counterfeit marked material
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 342 (Counterfeiting device or mark used for authenticating documents described in section 338, or possessing counterfeit marked material)
Section 342(1) - Counterfeiting a device or mark used for authenticating documents described in section 338 or possessing counterfeit marked material. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 342(2) - Counterfeiting a device or mark used for authenticating documents other than those described in section 338 or possessing counterfeit marked material. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Fraudulent cancellation, destruction, etc., of will, authority to adopt, or valuable security
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 343 (Fraudulent cancellation, destruction, etc., of will, authority to adopt, or valuable security)
Section 343 - Fraudulently destroying or defacing, or attempting to destroy or deface, or secreting, a will, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for 7 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Falsification of accounts
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 344 (Falsification of accounts)
Section 344 - Falsification of accounts. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Property mark
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 345 (Property mark)
Section 345(3) - Using a false property mark with intent to deceive or injure any person. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Tampering with property mark with intent to cause injury
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 346 (Tampering with property mark with intent to cause injury)
Section 346 - Removing, destroying or defacing property mark with intent to cause injury. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Counterfeiting a property mark
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 347 (Counterfeiting a property mark)
Section 347(1) - Counterfeiting a property mark used by another, with intent to cause damage or injury. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 347(2) - Counterfeiting a property mark used by a public servant, or any mark used by him to denote the manufacture, quality, etc., of any property. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years and fine. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Making or possession of any instrument for counterfeiting a property mark
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 348 (Making or possession of any instrument for counterfeiting a property mark)
Section 348 - Fraudulently making or having possession of any die, plate or other instrument for counterfeiting any public or private property mark. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 349 (Selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark)
Section 349 - Knowingly selling goods marked with a counterfeit property mark. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Making a false mark upon any receptacle containing goods
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 350 (Making a false mark upon any receptacle containing goods)
Section 350(1) - Fraudulently making a false mark upon any package or receptacle containing goods, with intent to cause it to be believed that it contains goods, which it does not contain, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 350(2) - Making use of any such false mark. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Criminal intimidation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 351 (Criminal intimidation)
Section 351(2) - Criminal intimidation. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 351(3) - If threat be to cause death or grievous hurt, etc. Punishment: Imprisonment for 7 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 351(4) - Criminal intimidation by anonymous communication or having taken precaution to conceal whence the threat comes. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, in addition to the punishment under section 351(1). Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 352 (Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace)
Section 352 - Insult intended to provoke breach of the peace. Punishment: Imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Statements conducing to public mischief
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 353 (Statements conducing to public mischief)
Section 353(1) - False statement, rumour, etc., circulated with intent to cause mutiny or offence against the public peace. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 353(2) - False statement, rumour, etc., with intent to create enmity, hatred or ill-will between different classes. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 years, or fine, or both. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.
Section 353(3) - False statement, rumour, etc., made in place of worship, etc., with intent to create enmity, hatred or ill-will. Punishment: Imprisonment for 5 years and fine. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Act caused by inducing person to believe that he will be rendered an object of Divine displeasure
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 354 (Act caused by inducing person to believe that he will be rendered an object of Divine displeasure)
Section 354 - Act caused by inducing a person to believe that he will be rendered an object of Divine displeasure. Punishment: Imprisonment for 1 year, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Misconduct in public by a drunken person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 355 (Misconduct in public by a drunken person)
Section 355 - Appearing in a public place, etc., in a state of intoxication, and causing annoyance to any person. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 24 hours, or fine of 1,000 rupees, or both or with community service. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Defamation
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 356 (Defamation)
Section 356(2) - Defamation against the President or the Vice-President or the Governor of a State or Administrator of a Union territory or a Minister in respect of his conduct in the discharge of his public functions when instituted upon a complaint made by the Public Prosecutor. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine or both, or community service. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 356(2) - Defamation in any other case. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine or both, or community service. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 356(3) - Printing or engraving matter knowing it to be defamatory against the President or the Vice-President or the Governor of a State or Administrator of a Union territory or a Minister in respect of his conduct in the discharge of his public functions when instituted upon a complaint made by the Public Prosecutor. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 356(3) - Printing or engraving matter knowing it to be defamatory, in any other case. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
Section 356(4) - Sale of printed or engraved substance containing defamatory matter, knowing it to contain such matter against the President or the Vice-President or the Governor of a State or Administrator of a Union territory or a Minister in respect of his conduct in the discharge of his public functions when instituted upon a complaint made by the Public Prosecutor. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
Section 356(4) - Sale of printed or engraved substance containing defamatory matter, knowing it to contain such matter in any other case. Punishment: Simple imprisonment for 2 years, or fine, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.

section_title: Breach of contract to attend on and supply wants of helpless person
text:
BNSS First Schedule - classification of the offence under BNS Section 357 (Breach of contract to attend on and supply wants of helpless person)
Section 357 - Being bound to attend on or supply the wants of a person who is helpless from youth, unsoundness of mind or disease, and voluntarily omitting to do so. Punishment: Imprisonment for 3 months, or fine of 5,000 rupees, or both. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

section_title: Offences against other laws
text:
BNSS First Schedule, Part II - classification of offences against other laws
Where an offence is created by an Act other than the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, it is classified by the punishment it carries:
If punishable with death, imprisonment for life, or imprisonment for more than 7 years. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Court of Session.
If punishable with imprisonment for 3 years and upwards but not more than 7 years. Cognizable. Non-bailable. Triable by: Magistrate of the first class.
If punishable with imprisonment for less than 3 years or with fine only. Non-cognizable. Bailable. Triable by: Any Magistrate.

source: K. Ravi Kumar vs State Of Karnataka (Supreme Court of India, 2014)
section_title: Culpable homicide not amounting to murder
text:
K. Ravi Kumar vs State Of Karnataka (Supreme Court of India, 2014)

As indicated hereinabove, in our view, the filing of charge-sheet is sufficient compliance with the provisions of Section 167(2)(a)(ii) in this case.

source: Commencement of the new criminal codes
section_title: Commencement of the new criminal codes
text:
Commencement of the new criminal codes
The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (BNS, 358 sections), the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (BNSS, 531 sections) and the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (BSA, 170 sections) came into force on 1 July 2024. They replace the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and the Indian Evidence Act, 1872 respectively. The new criminal codes came into force on 1 July 2024. Offences committed on or after that date are dealt with under the new codes; matters registered earlier continue under the old codes.
